purpose: Non-competing discoverability addendum for authority layers added after the current large manifest revision. The parent manifest remains authoritative for its indexed corpus; this file supplies only missing references and corrections until a safe full-file manifest normalization is performed.
safeguards: This addendum does not reorder the parent authority chain.
The Ar'nock technology correction authority outranks stale lower-authority biological-default descriptors.

Maintenance evidence adapters, operating-envelope evidence, family-response evidence, abort-operation scheduling evidence, dynamic-escape evidence, predictive-horizon evidence, uncertainty evidence, and route-predictive closure do not select transit family.
Technology-specific source packets remain preserved beside normalized evidence.
Unknown evidence remains unresolved rather than being replaced by zero or a nominal default.
Unknown uncertainty remains unresolved when an authority requires uncertainty evidence; it is not silently replaced by zero uncertainty.
Standard uncertainty is not a hard safety bound without an explicit coverage factor and declared statistical/model semantics.
Missing covariance is not zero covariance and is not proof of independence.
Hidden-mass probability is not a conservative distance-to-hazard without an explicit physical/model mapping.
Endpoint-occupancy probability is not an empty-volume or emergence-clearance certificate.
Route safety owns blocker localization; predictive safety may consume that blocker but may not reinterpret or invent its family physics.

Family dynamic-response authority owns the physical meaning and admissible machinery models for each abort sequence; the generic dynamic escape authority owns conservative stage-time and reserve combination.

Abort-operation scheduling authority owns explicit operation precedence, concurrency feasibility, shared-resource capacity checks, consumable reserve checks and critical-path timing; it does not invent family physics or route geometry.
A precedence-valid abort graph is not resource-valid unless every modeled overlap respects certified capacity.
When otherwise-concurrent operations exceed a shared certified resource, the generator may not invent priority or serialization; absent explicit arbitration authority the schedule remains UNRESOLVED.
Array order, prose order, species identity, technology tier and aesthetic machinery style are not scheduling authority.
A shared-resource conflict may not be hidden by averaging peak demand across the full abort interval.
A valid abort schedule may increase present intervention burden but may not reduce a certified baseline without explicit recertification authority.
Dynamic escape authority owns present machinery response burden when degraded-state evidence is supplied; route safety does not invent that timing.
A certified intervention time is not an immutable constant under arbitrary damage, rerouting, thermal saturation or reduced actuator/power authority.
No generic damage percentage, species multiplier, technology-tier response multiplier or unsupported degradation factor may be converted into emergency response time.
Stored energy and instantaneous deliverable power remain separate certificates.
Family-specific energy-transfer, slew, impulse or thermal equations may be used only when a family or machinery authority establishes the corresponding physical variable and required operation.
Concurrent versus sequential abort operations require explicit scheduling authority; the generator may not choose max or sum merely for convenience.
A continuous-family blocker distance must be traced to family-certified route geometry or an explicit stronger authority; no generic hazard distance is fabricated.
PRECOMMIT and portal families retain commitment/admission deadline semantics and do not receive fabricated continuous projected velocities.
Predictive PASS cannot promote a route REJECTED disposition and route ADMISSIBLE cannot erase predictive, family-response or dynamic-escape BLOCK.

Operational route admission is conjunctive: favorable route physics cannot erase blocking maintenance, uncertainty-aware operating-envelope, family-response, abort-scheduling, dynamic-escape, predictive-horizon, or route-predictive closure evidence, and healthy machinery cannot erase a route blocker.
A request must lie fully inside its uncertainty-adjusted certified scalar operating intervals; partial overlap is not certification.
Coupled operating constraints are conservatively evaluated from requested interval bounds unless a justified covariance-aware model is explicitly supplied.
Covariance-aware linear constraints require a valid normalized covariance matrix, declared variable order, distribution/model semantics, and coverage factor.
Predictive available time is conservative: lower-bound prediction/distance may only decrease under bounded uncertainty while upper-bound intervention/progress burden may only increase.
Continuous projected-progress, PRECOMMIT, and portal admission horizons retain distinct semantics; no local superluminal hull velocity is fabricated for PRECOMMIT or gate families.
Operating-envelope confidence or predictive coverage is not a probability of successful transit.

A conditional maintenance, operating-envelope, family-response, abort-scheduling, dynamic-escape, predictive-horizon, or route-predictive closure certificate may downgrade an otherwise ADMISSIBLE route to MARGINAL but may never be silently promoted to full admission.

No universal maintenance-certificate lifetime, operating-envelope limit, predictive advisory margin, dynamic-escape reserve margin, family abort duration, abort resource priority, uncertainty coverage factor, correlation model, statistical distribution, blocker distance, or route-progress rate is invented; each requires explicit authority.
